needed.evidence: A wide, unpaved gravel and dirt shoulder is used for parking, with no paved or purpose-built footway for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the ocean-side shoulder, separating pedestrians from the parked vehicles and the travel lane.

needed.evidence: The informal path and shoulder on the right side are completely occupied by a long line of parked vehicles, including a white pickup and several sedans.
needed.suggestion: Implement a no-parking zone along the right-hand verge to keep the pedestrian route clear of vehicles.

needed.evidence: The residential nature of the street with homes on the left and a scenic area on the right creates high crossing demand, yet there are no marked or physical ker
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility signage at the mid-point of the residential block.

needed.evidence: While some poles are visible, they are spaced far apart and the long stretches of the road between them are dark, failing to provide continuous lighting.
needed.suggestion: Increase the density of street lighting along the road to ensure continuous illumination for both pedestrians and drivers during the evening.
